name: Hòn Mun
kicker: The swim shore on Hòn Mun
summary: Hòn Mun is the island swim in the bay. The tourism bureau says about 350 coral species, more than 40 percent of the world’s hard corals, and water planned as Vietnam’s first marine protected area. Vietnam Tourism calls it the country’s only protected marine reserve. A visitor hour and a ticket for the shore were not printed. The bay listing clock is not a curfew.
getThere: A boat from the city. Minutes were not printed.
heroCaption: People in the clear water along the Hòn Mun shore
body: The picture is the shore: rocks, huts, and people in the water. The tourism bureau is where the coral figures live. It says about 350 coral species at Hòn Mun, more than 40 percent of the world’s hard corals, and that the water was planned as Vietnam’s first marine protected area. Vietnam Tourism calls Hòn Mun Vietnam’s only protected marine reserve. Those two claims are not the same sentence. Both stay.

The provincial tourism department prints listing hours of 09:00–22:00 for the bay. That clock is not a rule for this swim. A boat timetable was not printed. A shore ticket was not printed. Check on arrival. The city beach is the sand you can walk to. This one is a boat.
